title: Houston names 'the Hill', a telepathic chat room for non-speakers

tellings.quote: coined this term this the talk on the hill which was this telepathic chat room where non-speakers can tune in and communicate with each other

plain: A young non-speaking person named Houston is said to have coined the name "the Hill" for a kind of telepathic chat room, a place in the mind where people who cannot speak tune in and talk with one another. The documentary filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a series called The Telepathy Tapes about non-speaking people said to read minds, relays this from what Houston and others named Akil, John Paul and Libby told her in Atlanta around 2023. If true, it would mean these people share a hidden way of communicating with each other.
